name: Step Player
one_line: An iOS-style stepped progress track with a play, pause and replay control. The active step stretches into a bar that fills as it plays.
licence: free to use, repo reports NOASSERTION
withheld_reason: their repo reports NOASSERTION rather than a named licence

verdict.reason: A player for a sequence of steps — the closest thing here to a worked solution advancing one line at a time.
